moreFacts.label: Shape interpretation
moreFacts.value: Released New Horizons contact-binary shape: two overlapping closed lobe meshes. Southern surface detail is constrained by flyby imagery; the unseen side is a source model estimate.

moreFacts.label: Albedo coverage
moreFacts.value: Published LORRI albedo fit in the released per-lobe OBJ UV mapping, shown with a grayscale stretch. The source retains a uniform baseline where imagery is unconstrained and supplies no observation-coverage mask; uniform areas must not be interpreted as measured albedo. This is a model map, not a global photograph.

controls.label: Modeled albedo
controls.notes: Fitted from 30 New Horizons approach observations on 31 December 2018 and 1 January 2019. Grayscale shows the released albedo values. Uniform areas are unconstrained model fill; the archive supplies no coverage mask. This is a fitted surface model, not a global photograph.

controls.label: Shape model
controls.notes: Released New Horizons contact-binary shape: two overlapping closed lobe meshes. Southern surface detail is constrained by flyby imagery; the unseen side is a source model estimate. Revised pole from the bundled Porter paper Table 2. Its PDS XML gives an inconsistent earlier pole; the paper pole is used with arbitrary meridian and no precision spin-phase claim. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
